name: Voltline: Realistic E-Scooter Simulator [Beta]
desc:
The ultimate e-scooter simulator. Start with a KuKirin G4 and an AOVOPRO ES80, build your dream setup, and feel every turn.

📦 Unbox and assemble your starter scooters.
🛴 Make food deliveries, earn cash, and work toward your next scooter, including the VSETT 9+.
🔧 Make your build your own with compatible batteries, motors, controllers, brakes, tires, and suspension.
📱 Manage deliveries, navigation, shopping, and your garage from your in-game phone.
🔋 Charge up, watch your battery, and track every mile you ride.

Your scooter. Your setup. Your next ride.

BETA · ALL PLATFORMS
Available on every platform and device Roblox supports. Expect bugs, balance changes, and unfinished areas while Voltline is in Beta.

Follow Voltline for updates. Found a bug? Tell us which scooter you were riding and what happened.

llm.loop: unbox and assemble an electric scooter -> do food deliveries with an in-game phone -> earn money -> fit batteries, motors and brakes -> work toward premium scooter models
llm.instructions: unpack and assemble, deliver, fit parts, charge, track miles; early testing on desktop
unique: hyper-real hobby sim using real scooter brands and models
llm.thumbnails: photoreal scooter rides along a lakeside road at sunset; a handlebar speedometer
llm.complexity_notes: realistic vehicle model, part system, delivery map
